title: Lee & Cindy C.
description: Lee is a musician and plays in a band together with his high school friends. He wants to build a musical career but realizes his less then talented friends aren't going to take him anywhere. Luckily, he has the support of his uncle, Dolf. A second rate clown and an alcoholic. Cindy C is a Flemisch crooner who want to revive her career. However, she struggles with her conscience and no longer wishes to lie and cheat in the pitfall that is show business. When Lee and Cindy C meet, two different worlds collide and they will have to fight for their love.

title: The Missing Piece
description: After an accident leaves Shen Mo with amnesia, he mistakes Ji Mingxuan, the man who saved him, for his lover. But when Shen Mo regains his memories, the six months they spent loving each other become completely erased. Desperate to keep Shen Mo by his side, Ji Mingxuan proposes a three-year “contract lover” arrangement. When two people are already in love, can a contract still keep their hearts in check?⠀

title: The Heart [Hindi]
description: Zhou Xiaofeng, Fang Xiaoran, and Lin Yi, three cardiologists, met by chance at the Heart Center of Dongli Hospital. Due to their different professional backgrounds and professional beliefs, the three of them encountered friction and collision, and gradually reached a tacit understanding in the process of treating illnesses and saving lives, ultimately fighting side by side on the battlefield of life.

title: Sky C.
description: Sofia (AKA Sky) is a single mom supporting her daughter and her father. Growing up in the gym watching her father train to become a professional boxer her passion has always been to become a MMA pro-fighter. Her father's dream was cut short in the fight that would make him a professional boxer, when he sustained a spinal injury confining him to a wheelchair. Now her father is adamantly against Sky having any part of fighting for fear of her succumbing to the same fate he endures. But Sky passion for fighting could not be extinguished, so she continued to train in between working, being a mother and caretaker. After losing her main source of income, financial struggles ensue that forces her to secretly take underground fights to make money to support her family. One night she knocks out an opponent and it turns out to be the current MMA champion. The crowd has it all on video and the footage goes viral causing the MMA champion to challenge her to a real match that proves that Sky's knockout was just lucky. The viral footage gets back to her father and he further finds that his best friend was part of her training. The father confronts them both and the argument reveals the truth of why he didn't want Sky to fight. Sky leaves with her daughter and begins training for the fight of her life, without her father, until the day of the fight.

title: The C-Word
description: Follows Nyle McClain's journey of celibacy.

title: Angels Fall Sometimes
description: Two college students, Lin Tuo and An Zhi Que, fall in love but face a challenge when Lin Tuo is diagnosed with ALS. Despite the disease, he bravely fights on, inspiring others with his resilience and zest for life.

title: Love is Sweet [Hindi]
description: It follows the story of a girl named Jiang Jun who meets her close childhood friend, Ma Yuanshuai, in the workplace-this time, however, not as an ally but as a rival - Jiang Jun is an educated woman with a double degree in economics and psychology. Her parents liberal ways of raising her gave rise to her strong, independent, and idealistic character. After graduating from college, she begins to work for a non-profit organization to follow her dream of helping others. However, her father's sudden death leaves her on a crucial crossroad in her life. She decides to join MH, a top investment company, to fulfill her father's dying wish. Jiang Jun runs into her childhood friend Ma Yuanshuai, yet he's different from the gentle and caring protector that she remembered him to be. He is now her rival at work. Furthermore, someone seems to be plotting against her and she must rely on her wits and will to succeed not just in her career, but also in love.

title: La macchina delle immagini di Alfredo C.
description: At the end of the Second World War, the Communist Party took power in Albania. In the country there were still about 27,000 Italian veterans and civilians. They were prevented to go back home. Among them there was also a cameraman.

title: Sweet Trap [Hindi]
description: Cooking apprentice Li Nai sees her chef lose a cooking battle to Jiang Jie. As a result, the chef loses his 5 stars and has to close the restaurant. Li Nai wants to avenge him, unaware she used to be friends with Jiang Jie.

title: Charlotte
description: The story takes place in an alternate reality where a small percentage of children manifest superhuman abilities upon reaching puberty. A focus is placed on Yuu Otosaka, a high school boy who awakens the ability to temporarily possess others, which brings him to the attention of Nao Tomori, the student council president of a school founded as a haven for children with such abilities.

title: More of Me
description: Alice is a burnt out. She tries to keep her kids in order, her husband happy, and runs a cause of trying to save a tree she loves. One day when looking in her three way mirror, she wishes there was more of her. All of a sudden, the three reflections of Alice pop out of the mirror. One version is motherly and takes care of her kids, the second one works on the cause that Alice is fighting, and the final version of Alice is oversexed and just wants to please Alice's husband, Rex. The trade off is that the real Alice becomes invisible. At first, Alice enjoys her peace and quiet, but when her alter egos start running amok and start doing things she doesn't like, Alice vows to take her life back.

title: The CEO's Secret Wife
description: Emily marries Michael for her grandmother's medical costs. Sarah steals Emily's jade pendant and impersonates Michael's life-saver from three years ago. Though promising Sarah everything, Michael falls for Emily. When truth emerges, he pursues Emily.

title: Ascension d'un Prodigue ( Doublé )
description: Un docteur en mécanique et matériaux se retrouve dans le passé, incarnant Mathis Bernard, un prodigue. Sa famille et sa femme Lola Dubois sont hypothéquées. Grâce à ses connaissances modernes, il fait prospérer le Village des Bernard, et transforme la vie des habitants. Ses choix paraissent extravagants, mais il résout les crises les unes après les autres, et finit par gagner la reconnaissance de Lola.
